name: E3 ecliptic field 00 (lon 70.40, lat -0.33)
corr_colormap: blue #56B4E9 (negative) - black - orange #E69F00 (positive), clipped at +-8 sigma
confidence_rule: unexplained: clip(0.5 + (|peak| - 5)/20, 0, 1); known asteroid: 1 (catalogued orbit; SkyBoT position error in pos_err_arcsec)
asteroid_labels: IMCCE SkyBoT cone search (geocentric, LOC=500), V < 21, 38 queries; positions moved to each frame time with SkyBoT rates. Approximation: geocentric positions; SPHEREx's low-Earth-orbit view differs by <~1 arcsec for main-belt asteroids (more for near-Earth objects)
rerun_command: scripts/build_field.py --name e3_ecl00 --ra 68.839988 --dec 21.684231 --size 48 --max-frames 250 --title E3 ecliptic field 00 (lon 70.40, lat -0.33)
